name: let-me-go-home
description: Lightweight Ralph + Deep Interview plugin for Claude Code.

projectRoot.title: Project root
projectRoot.description: The repository that runs the phase chain, shown on the line above the prompt. Empty uses this session's own project root.

sessionId.title: Chain session id
sessionId.description: The session id that owns the chain state under .lmgh/state/sessions. Empty uses this session's own id.

debugFile.title: Debug file
debugFile.description: Absolute path of a JSON file that receives the shown line and any read failures whenever they change. Empty writes nothing.
